7.10
Mobile Application
A dedicated Android and iOS application can be developed to allow researchers to upload
documents, perform semantic searches, and interact with the AI assistant directly from
mobile devices.
7.11
Future Vision
The long-term vision of this project is to develop a comprehensive AI-powered research
platform capable of assisting students, researchers, academicians, and industry profes-
sionals throughout the entire research lifecycle. By integrating advanced Artificial In-
telligence, cloud computing, semantic search, and collaborative tools, the Intelligent Re-
search Assistant can evolve into a complete digital research companion for academic and
industrial applications.
